name: 词频排名分析
description: 分析 词频 ranking 分布.
useCase: 通过Zipf定律偏差检测AI文本
mechanism: 计算 trigram frequency 分布 and checks compliance with Zipf's law. AI生成的 text tends to deviate from natural frequency rankings.
source: Jawahar et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey
parameters: 窗口大小: 自适应, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: 熵, CV, 相关性
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI生成的 text
- Language-agnostic 统计 approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger 误报
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies 跨 写作风格s

references.title: Jawahar et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey
Gehrmann, S. et al. (2019). GLTR: Statistical Detection and Visualization of Generated Text. ACL Demo.
Solaiman, I. et al. (2019). Release Strategies and the Social Impacts of Language Models. OpenAI Technical Report.
